ABOUT.TITLE: About Us
ABOUT.LEAD: Since {{year}}, {{name}} has stood by farmers with quality products, sound advice and real care for every crop.
ABOUT.STORY_1: {{name}} opened its doors in {{year}} with a simple goal: to give farmers what they need for a healthy and plentiful harvest.
ABOUT.STORY_2: Over these {{years}} years we have grown together with our customers. Today we offer a wide range of fertilizers, seeds and crop protection products, both retail and wholesale.
ABOUT.STORY_3: But what sets us apart is not just our products. It is our knowledge. We come to your field, look closely at your plants, identify the disease and give you the right solution, because every crop and every farmer deserves special care.
ABOUT.MISSION_TEXT: To give farmers reliable products and professional advice, so they get more from their land while keeping it healthy for the generations to come.
ABOUT.V1_TEXT: We only recommend what your crop really needs, not what costs the most.
ABOUT.V2_TEXT: We know the local soil, climate and crops, because we have worked with them every day since {{year}}.
ABOUT.V3_TEXT: We don't stop at the sale. We come to the field, look at your plants and stay by your side until harvest.
ABOUT.VISIT_TEXT: Come to the shop or give us a call. You will always find someone ready to listen and help.

CONTACT.TITLE: Contact & Location
CONTACT.LEAD: We are here for any question about products, orders or problems with your crops.
